description: This file contains helper methods, class definitions, and utility functions related to rendering back-ends in the ANGLE project, including resource serial management, pixel operations, incomplete texture handling, matrix uniforms, and index processing.

classes.name: ResourceSerial
classes.description: Manages serial numbers for resources, tracking dirty and empty states.

classes.name: Serial
classes.description: Represents a serial number with comparison operators and serialization support.

classes.name: SerialFactoryBase
classes.description: Template class for generating serial numbers, supporting thread-safe and non-thread-safe variants.

classes.name: FastCopyFunctionMap
classes.description: Maps pixel formats to copy functions for fast pixel data operations.

classes.name: PackPixelsParams
classes.description: Parameters for packing pixel data from source to destination.

classes.name: LoadImageFunctionInfo
classes.description: Holds a load image function and a flag indicating if conversion is needed.

classes.name: IncompleteTextureSet
classes.description: Manages incomplete textures used as placeholders in rendering.

classes.name: MultisampleTextureInitializer
classes.description: Interface for initializing multisample textures, e.g., to black.

classes.name: SetFloatUniformMatrixGLSL
classes.description: Template for setting matrix uniforms according to GLSL semantics.

classes.name: SetFloatUniformMatrixHLSL
classes.description: Template for setting matrix uniforms according to HLSL semantics.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a format ID exists in the FastCopyFunctionMap.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the copy function for a given format ID.

methods.name: PackPixels
methods.description: Copies and packs pixel data from source to destination based on parameters.

methods.name: getIncompleteTexture
methods.description: Returns an incomplete texture object, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: initializeMultisampleTextureToBlack
methods.description: Initializes a multisample texture to black (virtual method).

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the uniform matrix setting operation for GLSL or HLSL.

methods.name: GetMatrixUniform
methods.description: De-transposes a matrix uniform for API queries.

methods.name: GetFormatFromFormatType
methods.description: Returns an angle::Format reference based on GLenum format and type.

methods.name: ComputeStartVertex
methods.description: Calculates the starting vertex index for drawing.

methods.name: GetVertexRangeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves index range and vertex count info for drawing.

methods.name: ClipRectToScissor
methods.description: Clips a rectangle to the current scissor box, with optional Y-inversion.

methods.name: OverrideFeaturesWithDisplayState
methods.description: Overrides feature set based on display state.

methods.name: LineLoopRestartIndexCountHelper
methods.description: Calculates the number of indices in a line loop with restart indices.

methods.name: GetLineLoopWithRestartIndexCount
methods.description: Returns the index count for a line loop with restart indices.

methods.name: CopyLineLoopIndicesWithRestart
methods.description: Copies line loop indices, handling restart indices.

methods.name: GetSamplePosition
methods.description: Retrieves the position of a sample in multi-sampling.
